theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpo_tk_bounded_current
theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (T₀ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (c : ℝ), (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c) → |T₀ ω| ≤ C * c) → ∃ T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, (∀ ω, T ω = T₀ ω) ∧ T.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
